description: Header file defining utility functions and enums for parsing numbers in network protocols, including functions for parsing integers with various formats and error handling.

classes.name: ParseIntFormat
classes.description: Enumeration specifying the format to use when parsing integers, such as non-negative, optionally negative, and strict variants.

classes.name: ParseIntError
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the reason why a parsing function failed, including overflow, underflow, or parse error.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Parses a string as a 32-bit integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseInt64
methods.description: Parses a string as a 64-bit integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseUint32
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned 32-bit integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned 64-bit integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.
